name: Savory cheese & herb muffins
toddler_why: Soft, cheesy texture hides herbs; packed with calcium for growing teeth.
watch: Ensure cheese doesn't create hard bits; use soft mild varieties only.

name: Mini savory waffle sticks
toddler_why: Waffle texture is fun to hold; spinach cooked in blend stays hidden.
watch: Waffles dry out fast; pack in container to retain moisture. Test dryness first.

name: Baked polenta fries with cheese
toddler_why: Soft-cooked polenta sets into pliable fries; mild corn flavor is familiar.

name: Mini crustless spinach & feta quiche cups
toddler_why: Egg base provides iron & protein; spinach cooked down is safe and nutrient-dense.
watch: Feta can be salty—rinse crumbles first and use mild variety.

name: Baked mac & cheese cups (mini)
toddler_why: Familiar comfort-food texture; soft pasta + creamy cheese = high eat-rate.
watch: Pasta must be cooked past al dente so it's very soft; bake into cups to prevent drying.

name: Savory pumpkin & cheese baked muffins
toddler_why: Pumpkin base is naturally sweet & moist; cheese balances; turmeric adds iron.
watch: None; pumpkin moisture makes them tender.

name: Baked rice & vegetable cups (savory)
toddler_why: Rice acts as a binder; soft veg + egg make a cohesive finger-food.
watch: Rice must be fully soft; ensure veg pieces are minced (not chunky).

name: Cornbread mini muffins (no honey)
toddler_why: Naturally moist, mild corn flavor; no sugar needed if made savory with a touch of salt.
watch: Avoid any sugar or honey; keep savory with butter & salt for toddler preference.

name: Baked ham & cheese egg cups
toddler_why: Ham adds savory protein appeal; eggs + cheese = soft, familiar base.
watch: Use low-sodium ham (reduce salt further if processed deli meat); watch for hard chunks of ham—mince finely.

name: Baked cheese straws (soft-crumb version)
toddler_why: Finger-width strips are easy-grip; cheese flavor is familiar and craveable.
watch: Straws should be bendable, not crispy—bake at lower temp so they stay pliable.

name: Mini savory butternut squash & cheese muffins
toddler_why: Squash is naturally sweet; cheese adds savory balance; highly packable.
watch: None; purée must be smooth and cooled before mixing.

name: Baked pizza mini muffins (cheese & tomato base)
toddler_why: Pizza flavor is recognizable; tomato paste adds tang; muffin format is easy to hold.
watch: Use low-sodium tomato paste; bake until fully cooked through so muffins don't collapse when packed.
